The most sacred object in Israel
The Ark represented God's presence among the Israelites. And then, thousands of years ago, it disappeared.
According to biblical tradition, its most important contents were the stone tablets of the covenant: the Ten Commandments.
The lid was treated as a throne, which is why the box was where God was said to be.
The Ark went to war
Then the Ark disappeared
The CIA’s Bizarre Ark experiment
U.S. intelligence agencies funded research into whether supposed psychic abilities would be useful for espionage.
The viewer claimed to perceive a sacred container guarded somewhere in the Middle East, but remote viewing has never been scientifically proven to reliably locate hidden objects.
No proposed location has been archaeologically verified, so its fate remains a mystery.

cards.head: If someone showed up at your front doorstep right now with a basket of fruit and asked you to let them in, and you look in that basket and the fruit is rotten.
Let's unpack Galatians chapter 5.
PAUL SAYS THERE ARE TWO KINDS OF FRUIT
THIS IS THE ROTTEN FRUIT
THEN COMES THE GOOD FRUIT
NOTICE HE CALLS IT "FRUIT," NOT "RULES"
SO LOOK AT WHAT SOMEONE PRODUCES
AND THE SAME TEST APPLIES TO YOU
WHY THIS TEST OUTLASTED THE LETTER

THEY BELIEVED IN A HIGHER GOD
SO WHO CREATED OUR WORLD?
SOME IDENTIFIED HIM WITH THE GOD OF THE OLD TESTAMENT

cards.head: Julius Caesar was warned that something terrible would happen on the Ides of March.
A SEER SUPPOSEDLY WARNED HIM
HIS WIFE ALSO HAD A NIGHTMARE
THEN ONE OF THE CONSPIRATORS CHANGED HIS MIND
SOMEONE TRIED TO HAND HIM THE ENTIRE PLOT
THEN THE SENATORS SURROUNDED HIM
AND NO, WE DON'T KNOW THAT HE SAID "ET TU, BRUTE?"
Even the most famous line from Caesar's assassination is probably part of the legend rather than something we can confidently say he spoke.
WHY THE IDES BECAME A DATE PEOPLE KNOW
